hook: HYDRAA wins back *2.64 acres* of parks in Miyapur, Alwal
hook_b: Is your colony park still a park? Miyapur's 4 weren't
tldr: After residents complained, HYDRAA fenced 2.64 acres of colony parks in Miyapur and Alwal back from encroachers.

beats.what: HYDRAA removed sheds and fenced 2.20 acres in Miyapur and a 1,800 sq yd park site in Alwal.
beats.why: 4 of 10 parks in two HMDA layouts were encroached with sheds, rooms and parking.
beats.care: Your colony's layout park is public land. Prajavani complaints with documents can get it back.

cards.body: Miyapur: two HMDA-approved layouts (45 and 30 acres) in Prashanth Nagar had 10 parks. Four were taken over. Alwal: Sri Ganesh Enclave residents showed papers from 1969 and 1981 plus Bhuvan satellite images. Some people had allegedly registered the park site in their names.

cards.q: Does your colony have a usable park?
Through which programme did Miyapur residents complain?

viz.l: layout parks in Miyapur were encroached

learn.t: HMDA approves layouts only if they leave land for parks and roads. That land can't legally be sold or built on.

watch: Whether HYDRAA acts on the people who registered park land in their names.

sources.name: NewsMeter
sources.title: Four parks in HMDA-approved Miyapur layouts found encroached, HYDRAA steps in (25 Oct)
